answer_1.quote: We leverage the post-processing property of DP ... we utilize the generative capabilities of LLMs in order to fuse a set of private triples into one coherent text.
answer_1.outputs: Privatized text documents generated from private semantic triples

answer_2.quote: We evaluate coherence using the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm, specifically G-EVAL ... Each metric is given as a score on the scale of 0-1, and we use OpenAI's GPT-4O MINI as the evaluator.

answer_3.quote: We use the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm ... we use OpenAI's GPT-4O MINI (2024-07-18) as the evaluator for the five G-EVAL metrics.
methods: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation via DEEPEVAL with G-EVAL prompts
